name: Renjou Miyako
source:
Mayuka friendly neighbor that comes over to help her out. Is a kind widow that wouldn't expect to be friends with Mayuka. But due to Mayuka eccentric personality they became fast friends. 

[spoiler] Is a nympho that hasn't had much sex since her husband died.  Secretly was using protagonist to get pregnant at first because she never got chance to be a mother while her husband was still alive. [/spoiler]
